markets.headline: US equities close out a volatile July with financials at record highs and the Nasdaq posting its steepest monthly loss since March 2025, while Amazon's blowout cloud earnings sparked a sharp Friday rebound.

stories.title: Amazon Cloud Earnings Spark Broad Market Rally
stories.summary: Amazon's AWS cloud revenue expanded 37% YoY in Q2 2026 — its fastest growth since 2021 — sending shares surging over 15% and lifting Asian chip stocks like SK Hynix (+25%) and Samsung (+20%) in Friday's session.

stories.title: Nasdaq Suffers Steepest Monthly Loss Since March 2025
stories.summary: The Nasdaq-100 tumbled more than 7% in July, weighed down by geopolitical strife, volatile energy markets, Fed policy uncertainty, and a prolonged semiconductor sell-off that saw the VanEck Semiconductor ETF fall for four straight days.

stories.title: Financial Stocks Surge to Record Highs
stories.summary: Financial stocks outpaced all other S&P 500 sectors in early August, reaching record highs on the back of solid Q2 earnings and attractive valuations, with analysts flagging a potential breakout rally in the sector.

stories.title: S&P 500 and Dow End July Mixed; Dow Posts Fourth Straight Monthly Gain
stories.summary: The S&P 500 slipped 0.1% for July while the Dow edged up 0.3% to extend its winning monthly streak to four, as strong earnings from select Dow components offset broader tech and geopolitical headwinds.

stories.title: New York City Spared Debt Downgrade by Fitch and Moody's — For Now
stories.summary: Fitch and Moody's held their negative outlooks on New York City's $53 billion of general obligation debt ahead of a $1.5 billion bond offering, warning the city must narrow projected deficits or face a formal downgrade.

macro.headline: Central banks hold firm as Middle East energy shock keeps inflation elevated globally, with the Fed on hold at 3.50–3.75%, the Bank of England maintaining 3.75% with a hawkish split vote, and the ECB pausing at 2.25% after a June hike.

stories.title: Fed Holds Rates at 3.50–3.75% Amid Persistent Inflation and Iran Oil Shock
stories.summary: The FOMC kept the federal funds rate unchanged at its July 29 meeting, as core inflation remained above target and the Iran conflict continued to inject energy-price volatility, with markets now pricing in possible rate hikes rather than cuts for the rest of 2026.

stories.title: Bank of England Holds at 3.75%, Warns Inflation to Peak Near 3.2% in Q4
stories.summary: The BoE's MPC voted 6–3 to hold Bank Rate at 3.75% on July 30, with three members voting for a 25bp hike; the Bank's central projection showed CPI inflation peaking at around 3.2% in Q4 2026 due to Middle East energy spillovers.

stories.title: ECB Holds Deposit Rate at 2.25% After June Hike; Next Decision in September
stories.summary: At its July 23 meeting, the ECB left rates unchanged at 2.25%, pausing after raising rates in June due to higher inflation pressures from the Middle East conflict, with the next scheduled policy meeting concluding on September 10.

stories.title: US July Payrolls Report Looms After Weak June Print of 57,000 Jobs
stories.summary: Economists surveyed by Bloomberg expect the July nonfarm payrolls report (due August 7) to show an 85,000 gain, a partial recovery from June's surprisingly soft 57,000 reading, which raised fresh concerns about US labour market momentum.

stories.title: OECD Warns of Two-Track Global Outlook as Middle East Energy Shock Bites
stories.summary: The OECD warned that a prolonged disruption to Persian Gulf energy production — with supply constraints potentially persisting into late 2027 — could deliver significantly weaker global growth and substantially higher inflation across both 2026 and 2027.

ma.headline: Global M&A hits record first-half values in 2026, driven by landmark financial infrastructure, asset management, energy, pharma, and AI-healthcare consolidations totalling hundreds of billions of dollars.

stories.title: ICE to Acquire Bond-Trading Platform MarketAxess for $6 Billion
stories.summary: NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange agreed on July 30 to buy MarketAxess for $167 per share in cash — a 33% premium — in a $5.7 billion enterprise-value deal aimed at creating a premier end-to-end fixed-income marketplace spanning 2,100 institutional investors across 90+ countries.

stories.title: Nuveen Buys Schroders for £9.9 Billion ($13.5bn), Creating $2.5 Trillion AUM Giant
stories.summary: TIAA's investment arm Nuveen acquired UK asset manager Schroders in a £9.9 billion recommended cash deal, ending more than two centuries of independence for Britain's largest standalone asset manager and creating one of the world's largest active-management platforms.

stories.title: Engie Acquires UK Power Networks from CK Group for $14.2 Billion
stories.summary: French energy major Engie agreed to buy UK Power Networks — Britain's largest electricity distributor serving 8.5 million customers across London and southeast England — from Hong Kong's CK Group in a £15.8 billion enterprise-value transaction.

stories.title: Sun Pharma Acquires Merck Spin-off Organon for $11.75 Billion
stories.summary: India's Sun Pharma agreed to acquire Organon & Co. — a Merck spin-off with $6.2 billion in 2025 revenue — for $14.00 per share in an all-cash deal valuing the women's-health and biosimilars company at $11.75 billion, the largest biotech M&A deal of 2026 to date.

stories.title: Tempus AI Acquires Cancer-Test Maker Personalis for $1.5 Billion
stories.summary: AI-driven precision medicine firm Tempus AI announced on July 20 it would acquire Personalis for $16.25 per share — primarily in stock — in a $1.5 billion deal that folds Personalis's minimal residual disease (MRD) cancer-monitoring technology into Tempus's oncology platform.
